in_marathi.name: Kuldeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep well of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuldeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kula’ meaning ‘family’ and ‘deep’ meaning ‘deep well’. This name signifies a deep well of knowledge and wisdom within the family.
